This challenge will cover tidyverse and data visualization

## Task 1 - Take a dataset and recreate a plot

This task will give them a bar chart image and they will have to figure out how to recreate it using tidyverse and ggplot. 

Data-wrangling tasks:

- `filter()` out one variable that does not appear in the plot
- `group_by()` a variable and `summarize()` to get the counts
- `factor()` so the ordered bars end up in the correct order

Plotting tasks:

- Change axis labels
- Colour the bars by group
- Facet so the groups end up on separate panels


## Task 2 - Take a poorly-made plot and fix it

This task will be a bit more free-form in terms of their final output, but there will be some things they clearly need to fix. These could include:

- Axis labels unclear
- Variables need to be re-scaled
- Poor colour choices
- Plotted with wrong plot type (e.g., was made as a scatter plot but should be a boxplot)
